suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required only for the lightweight 'http' driver (->driver('http')), which scrapes via a plain HTTP request instead of a headless browser.
suggest.ext-ghostscript: System package ghostscript (the 'gs' binary): default engine for CapturedFile->text() (PDF text layer). Install via your OS, e.g. apt-get install ghostscript. Composer cannot install it.
suggest.ext-poppler-utils: System package poppler-utils (pdftotext, pdftoppm): needed for CapturedFile->text('poppler') and for rasterizing pages in CapturedFile->vision() (both 'ai' and 'tesseract'). Install via your OS, e.g. apt-get install poppler-utils. Composer cannot install it.
suggest.ext-tesseract-ocr: System package tesseract-ocr (the 'tesseract' binary): offline OCR for CapturedFile->vision('tesseract'). Install via your OS, e.g. apt-get install tesseract-ocr. Composer cannot install it.
